english.title: Disturb surface of Footpath/Highway/other highway to render it inconvenient for the exercise of the public right of way
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, so disturbed the surface of

(A)_[a footpath]_
(B)_[a bridleway]_
(C)_[any other highway which consisted of or comprised a carriageway other than a made-up carriageway]_

namely, **(..SPECIFY WAY..), as to render it inconvenient for the exercise of the public right of way in that **(..SPECIFY WRONGDOING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 131A of the Highways Act 1980.
